adminNotes.text:
Build notes — admin

• Shell: CSS grid [nav | main], h-dvh. ≥1280 full nav (248px); 768–1279 icon rail (84px); <768 bottom tab bar + safe-area padding.
• Tables: <table> with caption; tablet drops Order + Reason columns; mobile switches to card lists. Rows are clickable, but the reference is the real <button> for keyboard users.
• Drawer: role=dialog aria-modal, focus trap, Esc closes, focus returns to the row. 600px desktop, 560px tablet, full-screen sheet on mobile.
• Customer messages: every message renders as a text node only (never innerHTML/markdown), oldest first, with assistant replies muted in between. Tags: 'Used in decision' / 'After decision' / 'Not yet reviewed'. Threads over 4 entries show first + last 2 with 'Show N earlier'. Attachments are file chips, never previews. Injection matches are underlined + tinted AND explained in words, with the message number.
• Escalation decisions: note ≥10 chars, confirm dialog, then log {by, at, note}. Cancel is the default focus.
• Policy = typed rules (5 fixed kinds, scoped Refund window). Prose is generated from rules, never edited. Hash = digest of the normalized rules.
• Validation runs client + server; field errors inline, summary on submit. Duplicate kind+scope is invalid on the later card.
• Saves use optimistic concurrency (If-Match: base version) → 409 shows the conflict banner and keeps the draft.
• Revert = new version copying the old rules, marked 'Reverted from vX'; history is append-only.
• AI review drafts are advisory, generated in the background after the customer is answered; failures never block a decision.
• Model name on the drawer is a placeholder — show whatever the backend logs.
• Settings → Customer disputes: role=switch with aria-checked, label + description linked. Server-side flag, read at dispute time; turning it off doesn't cancel disputes already sent.
• Disputed requests: Escalated with a 'Disputed' flag and 'Customer dispute' escalation reason; the timeline adds a Disputed step. Admin-decided requests show 'Approved/Denied after review'.
• Escalation chat: admin replies from the drawer are stored on the request with author {role: admin, name}; the customer sees them tagged Admin. Customer replies arrive tagged 'Not yet reviewed'. Chat locks once decided.

buildNotes.text:
Build notes

• Page shell: min-h-dvh (100dvh), never 100vh.
• Launcher: fixed right-4 bottom-[calc(1rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]; right-6 bottom-6 on desktop.
• Desktop panel: fixed, 400×600 (max-h: calc(100dvh-3rem)), shadow-lg, rounded-xl.
• Mobile (<640px): fixed inset-0 h-dvh sheet; pad with env(safe-area-inset-*). Needs viewport-fit=cover in the viewport meta.
• Esc closes; focus returns to the launcher (or the order's help link).
• 'Get help with this order' opens the widget with that order preselected; a new order starts a new thread.
• Thread is role=log aria-live=polite; verdict cards are <article> with the ref ID in the header.
• Composer: 16px font on mobile so iOS doesn't zoom; soft 500-char limit.
• Verdict card renders badge + ref first; explanation streams (aria-busy on the card until done, so screen readers get it once).
• Automatic-review failure → normal Escalated card; never an error to the customer.
• Once a request is decided (Approved / Denied, automatic or after review) or in progress, its order chip is marked with that status and can't be picked; the marker opens the request. In My orders the row's link becomes 'View refund request' and opens that request's read-only chat. Chat and table share one session list of requests.
• Pointer cursor on every enabled button, link, select, tab and label; not-allowed on disabled controls.
• Answered requests close: after Approved or Denied the composer is replaced by a full-width 'Start new request' button. Escalated stays open so the customer can add details.
• Your requests: each card opens a read-only transcript (no composer). Labels: Approved / Denied (automatic), Approved after review / Denied after review (admin).
• Dispute: only for automatic denials, only when the admin setting is on, once per request, with a confirm step. It moves the request to Escalations. Admin decisions are final — no dispute option.
• Add order (demo only): order number is next in sequence and read-only; dates use one accessible date picker (grid, arrow keys, Enter, Esc); catalog has 3 categories + search; total is computed; status Delivered (delivery date), Used (= order date), Confirmed (start date) or Active (since order date + duration). Suggests a status from the items and previews the likely decision. Added orders are tagged Test and work in the chat.
• My orders: 10 per page, Previous/Next + page numbers; adding a test order jumps to page 1.
• Chat order chips: only orders inside the refund window; first 5, 'Show N more' up to 8, then a hint to type any other order number (lookup still hits every order).
• Picking an order with an earlier decided item shows that request's history and status inline, plus a note that the rest of the order can still be requested.
• Thread auto-scrolls on every new message, streamed token and status change (instant scroll, no smooth animation).

liveNotes.text:
How the live chat works

• Escalated requests have a 'Message customer' box in the admin drawer (and a button on each Escalations card). Messages show in the customer's chat as the admin's name with an Admin tag.
• Customer side: a banner and a 'N new' badge on Your requests (and on the launcher when the chat is closed). Replies go back from the request view, or inline if the escalated chat is still open.
• Approve / Deny stay available the whole time. The decision is posted to the customer's chat, the request becomes 'Approved/Denied after review', the chat closes and the order locks.
• New escalations and disputes from the customer appear in the admin queue straight away.
• Demo transport: BroadcastChannel between artboards. Production: one conversation per request over WebSocket/SSE, messages stored server-side, author {role, name}, delivered + read receipts, rendered as text only.
